error-board-notAMember: Muyenera kukhala membala wa bolodi ili kuti muchite zimenezo

error-notAllowed: Udindo wanu pa bolodi sulolezedwa kuchita zimenezo
error-json-schema: Deta yanu ya JSON ilibe zambiri zoyenera mu kalembedwe kolondola
error-csv-schema: CSV (Zinthu Zolekanitsidwa ndi Zikhoma)/TSV (Zinthu Zolekanitsidwa ndi Tabu) yanu ilibe zambiri zoyenera mu kalembedwe kolondola
error-import-empty-board: Zotulutsa izi zilibe zomwe zili pa bolodi (palibe mizere yosambira, mindandanda kapena makhadi). Mwina zinapangidwa ndi mtundu wakale wa WeKan wokhala ndi cholakwika chodziwika cha kutulutsa. Chonde tulutsaninso bolodi ndi mtundu wapano ndipo lowetsani faelo yatsopanoyo.
error-linked-card-not-allowed: Mungangolumikiza ku khadi labwinobwino. Kulumikiza ku khadi lina lolumikizidwa, kapena ku khadi lomwe limalumikiza kubwerera ku bolodi ili, sikuloledwa chifukwa kungachititse makhadiwo kusafikirika.
error-username-taken: Dzina la wogwiritsa ntchito limeneli latengedwa kale
user-can-not-export-excel: Wogwiritsa ntchito sangathe kutumiza ku Excel
export-card-excel-fields: Sankhani malo oti aphatikizidwe potumiza ku Excel:
export-card-field-board-info: Zambiri za bolodi (Bolodi, Mndandanda, Mzere wosambira)
export-card-excel-no-disk-space: Sitingatumize ku Excel: malo aulere pa disiki sakukwana
user-can-not-export-card-to-pdf: Wogwiritsa ntchito sangathe kutumiza khadi ku PDF
user-can-not-export-card-to-excel: Wogwiritsa ntchito sangathe kutumiza khadi ku Excel
filter-date-range-invalid: Sankhani madeti oyenera; deti lomaliza liyenera kukhala lofanana ndi loyambira kapena likhale pambuyo pake.
filter-column-age-disabled: Musabise potengera nthawi yomwe khadi lakhala m'ndandanda
filter-column-age-hint: Bisani makhadi amene analowa m'ndandandawu masiku oposa chiwerengerochi apitawo. Mindandanda ina ndi makhadi omwe madeti awo olowera sakudziwika amaonekabe. Kusintha khadi sikuyambiritsanso nthawi yake m'ndandanda.
filter-on-desc: Mukusefa makhadi pa bolodi ili. Dinani apa kuti musinthe sefa.
advanced-filter-card-dates-hint: Sefani madeti a makhadi pogwiritsa ntchito @createdAt, @receivedAt, @startAt, @dueAt, @endAt kapena @listEnteredAt. Chitsanzo: @endAt >= '2026-01-01' kapena @endAt = none. Ikani dzina la malo amene mwapanga lomwe limayamba ndi @ pakati pa zizindikiro za mawu ogwidwa.
advanced-filter-description: Sefa yapamwamba imalola kulemba mawu okhala ndi zizindikiro izi: == != <= >= && || ( ) Danga limagwiritsidwa ntchito kulekanitsa zizindikirozo. Mungasefe malo onse apadera polemba mayina ndi mitengo yake. Mwachitsanzo: Field1 == Value1. Dziwani: Ngati malo kapena mitengo ili ndi mipata, muyenera kuizungulira ndi zizindikiro za mawu amodzi. Mwachitsanzo: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Kuti zilembo zapadera chimodzi (' \/) zilumphidwe, mungagwiritse ntchito \. Mwachitsanzo: Field1 == I\'m. Mungaphatikizenso zinthu zingapo. Mwachitsanzo: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Nthawi zambiri zizindikiro zonse zimatanthauziridwa kuchokera kumanzere kupita kumanja. Mungasinthe dongosolo poika mabulaketi. Mwachitsanzo: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Mungafufuzenso m'malo a mawu pogwiritsa ntchito regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i
text-contains-trigger-description: Zimagwirizana pamene kadi yalengedwa, kapena mutu wake kapena kufotokoza kwake kwasinthidwa, ndipo mawu atsopano ali ndi izi (osasiyanitsa zilembo zazikulu ndi zazing'ono).
header-logo-title: Bwererani ku tsamba la mabolodi anu.
imported-member-no-account: Membala walowetsedwa — palibe akaunti yofanana pano
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Matani JSON yotumizidwa kuchokera ku Kanboard: chinthu chokhala ndi "columns" (kapena ntchito zokhala ndi column_name) ndi mndandanda wa "tasks" (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Mizati imakhala mindandanda ndipo ntchito zimakhala makhadi.
import-board-instruction-deck: Matani JSON ya bolodi la NextCloud Deck (bolodi lokhala ndi "stacks", ndipo stack iliyonse ili ndi "cards" zake). Stacks zimakhala mindandanda ndipo makhadi amakhalabe makhadi.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Matani JSON ya gulu la work-packages la OpenProject (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Ma status amakhala mindandanda ndipo work packages zimakhala makhadi.
import-board-instruction-issues: Matani mndandanda wa JSON wa ma issue a __sourceName__ (__endpoint__). Ma issue amakhala makhadi ogawidwa m'mindandanda ya Open / Closed.
import-board-instruction-asana: Matani JSON yotumizidwa ya ntchito za Asana ({ "data": [...] } kuchokera potumiza kwa Asana kapena GET /tasks). Ntchito zimagawidwa m'magawo (memberships); ntchito zomalizidwa zimapita ku Done.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Matani JSON yotumizidwa ya mndandanda wa ZenKit ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Stages zimakhala mindandanda ndipo items zimakhala makhadi.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Kumbirani mndandanda wa ntchito wa markdown (msinkhu umene zida za markdown-kanban monga Obsidian Kanban zimagwiritsa ntchito): mitu ya "## Dzina la mndandanda", ndi zinthu za "- [ ]"/"- [x]" pansi pake. Mitu imasanduka mindandanda ndipo zinthu zimasanduka makhadi.
import-board-instruction-leo: Matani dongosolo la Leo (fayilo ya .leo). Mfundo zapamwamba zimakhala mindandanda, mfundo zake zazing'ono zimakhala makadi ndipo mawu a mfundoyo amakhala kufotokoza kwa khadi. Mfundo zakuya kwambiri zimakhala mindandanda yowunikira. Mfundo zolembedwa chizindikiro zimatumizidwa mkati ngati zomalizidwa.
import-board-instruction-opml: Matani ndondomeko ya OPML, monga momwe Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq ndi mapulogalamu ena a ndondomeko amaitulutsira. Zinthu za pamwamba zimakhala mindandanda, ana awo amakhala makhadi ndi cholemba ngati kufotokoza, ndipo zinthu zakuya zimakhala mindandanda yowunika. Zinthu zomalizidwa zimalowetsedwa ngati zatha.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Matani fayilo ya Org mode, monga momwe Emacs, Orgzly kapena Beorg amailembera. Mitu ya pamwamba imakhala mindandanda ndipo mitu ya gawo lachiwiri imakhala makhadi. TODO ndi DONE, zofunika kwambiri, ma tag, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE ndi CLOSED zimasungidwa, ndipo mabokosi owunika ndi mitu yakuya zimakhala mindandanda yowunika.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Matani fayilo ya todo.txt: ntchito imodzi pamzere uliwonse, monga pulogalamu ya todo.txt ndi mapulogalamu ogwirizana nayo zimalembera. Ntchito zomalizidwa ("x") zimapita ku Zomalizidwa, +project ndi @context zimakhala zilembo, (A) imakhala chizindikiro cha kufunika, ndipo due: ndi t: zimakhala masiku omalizira ndi oyambira.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Matani zotsatira za task export: mndandanda wa JSON kapena ntchito imodzi pamzere uliwonse. Ntchito zomalizidwa zimapita ku Done, project ndi priority zimakhala zilembo, annotations imakhala ndemanga, ndipo depends imakhala kudalira ntchito zomwe zimatsekereza.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Tsegulani fayilo ya .boardarchive kuchokera m’phukusi lopanikizidwa ndipo matani zomwe zili mu board.jsonl ya bolodi, ndi mzere wa mtundu kapena popanda iwo. Chinthu chogawa m’magulu pa mawonekedwe a bolodi chimakhala mindandanda, zinthu zina zosankha zimakhala zilembo, magawo a mawu ndi mabokosi ochonga amakhala kufotokoza ndi mndandanda woyang’anira, ndipo ndemanga zimasungidwa. Zithunzi ndi mafayilo olumikizidwa sizilowetsedwa.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: Mu MeisterTask, dinani dzina la pulojekiti, sankhani Export project ndipo tulutsani CSV, kenako imateni. Zigawo zimakhala mindandanda ndipo ntchito zimakhala makhadi, pamodzi ndi zolemba zawo, tsiku lomaliza, woperekedwa ntchito ndi ma tag; ntchito zomalizidwa zimasunga tsiku lomwe zinamalizidwa. CSV yolembedwera kulowetsa kwa MeisterTask komweko imagwiranso ntchito.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: Mu Obsidian, tsegulani fayilo ya bolodi la Kanban ngati Markdown (kapena tsegulani fayilo ya .md mu text editor), kenako matani yonse. Mizere imakhala mindandanda pamodzi ndi malire a makhadi awo, makhadi amasunga ma tag, masiku, zofunika kwambiri, malo ndi mndandanda wowunika, ndipo Archive imakhala makhadi a mu Zosungidwa.
import-board-instruction-linear: Mu Linear, tulutsani nkhani ngati CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, kapena kutulutsa kwa view), kenako matani CSV. Mikhalidwe imakhala mindandanda, magulu amakhala mizere yosambira, ndipo nkhani zimakhala makhadi pamodzi ndi woperekedwa ntchito, zilembo, masiku, nkhani ya kholo, zofunika kwambiri, kuyerekeza, pulojekiti ndi nthawi yozungulira.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: Mu TickTick, tsegulani Settings, Account, Backup & Import ndipo pangani backup, kenako matani fayilo ya CSV. Mndandanda uliwonse wa TickTick umakhala mzere wosambira ndipo mizati yake imakhala mindandanda; ntchito zimasunga ma tag, masiku, mndandanda wowunika, zofunika kwambiri ndi tintchito.
import-board-instruction-clickup: Mu ClickUp, tulutsani ntchito ngati CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, kapena kutulutsa kwa List kapena Table view ndi mizati yonse), kenako matani CSV. Mikhalidwe imakhala mindandanda, mindandanda ya ClickUp imakhala mizere yosambira, ndipo ntchito zimakhala makhadi pamodzi ndi tintchito, owaperekera ntchito, ma tag, masiku, zofunika kwambiri ndi nthawi.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Mu Nullboard, tsegulani bolodi, sankhani Export this board... pa menyu, tsegulani fayilo ya .nbx mu text editor ndipo matani zomwe zili mmenemo. Mindandanda imakhala mindandanda ndipo zolemba zimakhala makhadi: mzere woyamba wa cholemba ndi mutu wa khadi ndipo zotsalazo ndi kufotokoza kwake. Cholemba chosakonzedwa chimapatsidwa chizindikiro raw. Fayilo yokhala ndi mabolodi angapo imalowetsa bolodi lake loyamba.
import-board-instruction-kanri: Mu Kanri, tsegulani Import & Export ndipo sankhani Export individual board (kapena Export all data), kenako matani fayilo ya .json. Mizati imakhala mindandanda ndipo makhadi amakhala makhadi, pamodzi ndi kufotokoza, tsiku lomaliza, ma tag ndi mitundu yawo; ntchito za khadi zimakhala mndandanda wowunika. Kuchokera ku kutulutsa kwa deta yonse, bolodi loyamba limalowetsedwa.
import-board-instruction-planka: Lembani adiresi ya Planka yanu (mwachitsanzo https://planka.example.com), dzina logwiritsa ntchito ndi mawu achinsinsi a Planka, kenako dinani «Onetsani zomwe zingalowetsedwe». Zimagwiritsidwa ntchito kokha kutenga bolodi ndipo sizisungidwa. Sankhani bolodi ndipo dinani «Tengani»: WeKan imaliwerenga kuchokera ku API ya Planka pamodzi ndi mindandanda, makhadi, mafotokozedwe, masiku omaliza, zilembo, mamembala, mindandanda ya ntchito ndi ndemanga zake, kenako pitirizani kulowetsa monga mwa nthawi zonse. Makhadi omwe ali m'malo osungira a Planka amalowetsedwa ngati osungidwa; zomata ndi makhadi omwe ali mu zinyalala samalowetsedwa.
import-board-instruction-mstodo: Mu Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer), lowani, vomerezani chilolezo cha Tasks.Read ndipo koperani token kuchokera pa tabu ya Access token. Imateni apa ndipo dinani «Onetsani zomwe zingalowetsedwe»; token imagwiritsidwa ntchito pa kutenga uku kokha ndipo sisungidwa. Sankhani mindandanda yonse kapena umodzi ndipo dinani «Tengani». Mndandanda uliwonse wa To Do umakhala mndandanda ndipo ntchito iliyonse imakhala khadi, pamodzi ndi zolemba, masiku omaliza ndi oyambira, masitepe ngati mndandanda woyang'anira, magulu ngati zilembo, kufunika kwakukulu ndi momwe zilili ngati zilembo; ntchito zomalizidwa zimasungidwa. Zikumbutso ndi kubwereza samalowetsedwa.
import-board-instruction-kanbanflow: Mu KanbanFlow, tsegulani menyu ya bolodi, sankhani Settings → API & Webhooks ndipo koperani token ya API ya bolodi. Imateni token apa, dinani «Onetsani zomwe zingalowetsedwe», sankhani bolodi ndipo dinani «Tengani»; token imagwiritsidwa ntchito pa kutenga kumeneko kokha ndipo sisungidwa. Mizati imakhala mindandanda ndipo njira zimakhalabe njira; ntchito zimasunga mafotokozedwe, mtundu, zilembo, tsiku lomaliza, ntchito zazing'ono ngati mndandanda woyang'anira, nthawi yogwiritsidwa, kuyerekeza, anthu ndi ndemanga.
import-board-instruction-basecamp: Lembani ID ya akaunti yanu ya Basecamp (nambala pambuyo pa basecamp.com/ mu adiresi) ndi token yolowera (kuchokera ku pulogalamu ya OAuth 2 yolembetsedwa pa launchpad.37signals.com, kapena yomwe kulumikizana komwe kulipo kuli nayo kale), dinani «Onetsani zomwe zingalowetsedwe», sankhani pulojekiti ndipo dinani «Tengani». Token imagwiritsidwa ntchito pa kutenga kumeneko kokha ndipo sisungidwa. Tebulo lililonse la makhadi limakhala njira ndi mizati yake ngati mindandanda, ndipo mindandanda ya zochita imakhala njira «To-dos»; makhadi ndi zochita zimasunga mawu, masiku, opatsidwa ntchito ndi ndemanga, masitepe a khadi amakhala mndandanda woyang'anira, ndipo zochita zomalizidwa zimasungidwa.
import-board-instruction-googletasks: Pezani token yolowera kuchokera ku OAuth 2.0 Playground: pansi pa Tasks API v1 sankhani tasks.readonly, dinani Authorize APIs, kenako Exchange authorization code for tokens, ndipo koperani token yolowera. Imateni apa ndipo dinani «Onetsani zomwe zingalowetsedwe», sankhani mindandanda yonse ya ntchito kapena umodzi, kenako «Tengani». Token imagwiritsidwa ntchito pa kutenga uku kokha ndipo sisungidwa. Mindandanda ya ntchito imakhala mindandanda ndipo ntchito zimakhala makhadi, pamodzi ndi zolemba, maulalo ndi tsiku lomaliza; ntchito zazing'ono zimakhala mndandanda woyang'anira ndipo ntchito zomalizidwa zimalowetsedwa ngati zosungidwa.
import-board-instruction-googlekeep: API ya Google Keep ndi ya maakaunti a Google Workspace okha. Pezani token yolowera ya OAuth 2.0 yokhala ndi gawo https://www.googleapis.com/auth/keep.readonly (mu OAuth 2.0 Playground ngati woyang'anira Workspace wanu alola, kapena kuchokera ku akaunti ya ntchito yokhala ndi chilolezo cha domeni yonse), imateni, dinani «Onetsani zomwe zingalowetsedwe» kenako «Tengani». Token imagwiritsidwa ntchito pa kutenga uku kokha ndipo sisungidwa. Zolemba za mawu zimakhala makhadi mu mndandanda «Notes», ndipo zolemba za mndandanda woyang'anira zimakhala makhadi mu mndandanda «Lists» ndi zinthu zake ngati mndandanda woyang'anira. Zolemba za mu zinyalala, zomata ndi kugawana samalowetsedwa.
api-import-desc: Itengeni kuchokera ku ntchitoyo ndi akaunti yanu. Zomwe mulemba apa zimagwiritsidwa ntchito pa kutenga uku kokha ndipo sizisungidwa.
api-import-fetched: Zatengedwa. Onani mamembala ali m'munsimu ndipo lowetsani.
api-import-nothing: Palibe choti mulowetse ndi akaunti iyi.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: Mu Pivotal Tracker, tsegulani tabu ya MORE ya pulojekiti ndipo sankhani Export CSV (kapena sankhani nkhani ndikusankha Bulk Actions, CSV), kenako matani CSV. Mkhalidwe uliwonse wa nkhani umakhala mndandanda ndipo nkhani zimakhala makhadi, pamodzi ndi mtundu ndi zilembo zawo, eni ake, wopempha, masiku, ndemanga, ntchito ndi zotchinga; Estimate imakhala Story points ndipo ma iteration amakhala ma sprint.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: Mu Tasks.org, tsegulani Settings, Backups ndipo sankhani Export tasks, kenako matani zomwe zili mu fayilo ya .json imeneyo. Mindandanda imakhala mindandanda ndipo ntchito zimakhala makhadi, pamodzi ndi zolemba, ma tag, masiku, ndemanga ndi tintchito; ntchito zomalizidwa zimasunga tsiku lomwe zinamalizidwa, ndipo zofunika kwambiri zimakhala malo apadera.
import-board-instruction-monday: Mu monday.com, tsegulani menyu ya bolodi, sankhani More actions ndi Export board to Excel (ndi zosintha ndi tinthu tating'ono ngati mukufuna), kenako sankhani fayilo ya .xlsx imeneyo. Mzati wa Status umakhala mindandanda ndipo magulu amakhala mizere yosambira; anthu, masiku, ndondomeko ya nthawi ndi ma tag zimasunga malo awo, mizati ina imakhala malo apadera ndipo zosintha zimakhala ndemanga.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: Mu Super Productivity, tsegulani Settings, kenako Sync & Backup, sankhani Export Data ndipo matani zomwe zili mu fayilo ya sp-backup .json. Pulojekiti iliyonse imakhala mzere wosambira ndipo ntchito zimakhala makhadi mu To Do, In Progress, Backlog kapena Done, pamodzi ndi zolemba, ma tag, tsiku lomaliza, nthawi yogwiritsidwa ntchito ndi tintchito; ntchito za mu Zosungidwa zimakhala makhadi a mu Zosungidwa.
import-board-instruction-taiga: Mu Taiga, tsegulani Admin > Project > Export ndipo tsitsani dump ya pulojekiti (tsegulani kaye fayilo ya .json.gz), kenako matani JSON yake. Mikhalidwe ya user story imakhala mindandanda, ma user story amakhala makhadi ndi ntchito zawo ngati tintchito, ma epic ndi nkhani zimapeza mizere yosambira yawoyawo, ndipo ma sprint, ma tag, ndemanga ndi makhalidwe apadera zimabweranso. Zolumikizidwa sizilowetsedwa.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: Mu Vikunja, tsegulani Settings, sankhani Data Export ndipo tsitsani fayilo ya .zip yomwe ikutumizirani, kenako sankhani fayiloyo, kapena matani data.json yomwe ili mkati mwake. Ma bucket a Kanban amakhala mindandanda ndipo ntchito zimakhala makhadi, pamodzi ndi zilembo, owaperekera ntchito, masiku, kufotokoza, mindandanda ya ntchito ngati mindandanda yowunika ndi ndemanga; zofunika kwambiri, peresenti yomalizidwa ndi chomalizidwa zimakhala malo apadera. Zolumikizidwa sizilowetsedwa.
import-board-instruction-quire: Mu Quire, tsegulani menyu ya pulojekiti ndipo sankhani Export CSV, kenako matani CSV. Mikhalidwe imakhala mindandanda ndipo ntchito zimakhala makhadi, pamodzi ndi tintchito ngati makhadi ana, owaperekera ntchito, ma tag ngati zilembo, masiku oyambira, omaliza ndi omalizidwa, kufotokoza ndi zofunika kwambiri ngati malo apadera. Ndemanga ndi zolumikizidwa sizili mu CSV ya Quire.
import-board-instruction-wrike: Mu Wrike, tulutsani pulojekiti kapena foda ku Excel, kapena lembani template ya Wrike yolowetsera Excel, kenako sankhani fayilo ya .xlsx imeneyo. Mizere ya foda ndi pulojekiti imakhala mizere yosambira, Status imakhala mindandanda ndipo ntchito zimakhala makhadi, pamodzi ndi Key, ntchito ya kholo, owaperekera ntchito, masiku oyambira ndi omaliza, kudalirana ndi kufotokoza; Priority, Duration ndi mizati ina imakhala malo apadera.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: Mu Teamwork.com, lembani template ya Excel yolowetsera ntchito (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) ndipo isungeni ngati .xlsx, kenako sankhani fayiloyo. Mindandanda ya ntchito imakhala mindandanda ndipo ntchito zimakhala makhadi; ntchito yoyamba ndi -, # kapena > imakhala kantchito ka ntchito ya pamwamba pake (--, ## kapena >> gawo limodzi lakuya). Owaperekera ntchito, masiku ndi ma tag zimasunga malo awo; Priority, Estimated time ndi Complete zimakhala malo apadera.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: Mu Businessmap (yomwe kale inali Kanbanize), tsegulani Advanced Search, sankhani Configure results kuti musankhe mizati, tsitsani fayilo ya Excel, kenako sankhani fayilo ya .xlsx imeneyo. Mizati imawerengedwa ndi mayina awo a Chingerezi (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): ngati akaunti yanu imagwiritsa ntchito chilankhulo china, sinthani kaye mzere wa mitu kukhala Chingerezi. Column imakhala mindandanda ndipo Lane mizere yosambira; eni ake, ma tag, mtundu, masiku, ndemanga ndi maulalo a kholo zimasunga malo awo, ndipo Priority, Size, Type ndi mizati ina imakhala malo apadera.
import-board-instruction-redmine: Mu Redmine, tsegulani Issues za pulojekiti, sankhani Also available in: CSV pansi pa mndandanda, sankhani mizati (All columns, ndi Description) ndipo tulutsani, kenako matani CSV. Redmine imatchula mizati m'chilankhulo chanu, choncho ikani chilankhulo chanu kukhala Chingerezi mu My account musanatulutse. Mkhalidwe uliwonse umakhala mndandanda ndipo nkhani zimakhala makhadi, pamodzi ndi tracker ngati chizindikiro, woperekedwa ntchito, wolemba, masiku, ntchito ya kholo ndi nkhani zogwirizana; zofunika kwambiri, gulu, mtundu womwe ukuyembekezeka, nthawi yoyerekezedwa, % Done ndi malo apadera zimakhala malo apadera.
import-board-instruction-notion: Mu Notion, tsegulani database ngati tsamba lathunthu, sankhani ••• ndi Export, sankhani Markdown & CSV, ndipo sankhani fayilo ya .zip yomwe imatsitsa, kapena CSV imodzi ya database kuchokera mmenemo, kapena matani CSV imeneyo. Mzati wotchedwa Status umakhala mindandanda (popanda iwo, mzati woyamba wooneka ngati wosankha umatero, ndipo lipoti la kulowetsa limanena kuti ndi uti); mizere imakhala makhadi pamodzi ndi mutu, ma tag ngati zilembo, anthu ngati mamembala, masiku, ndi mawu a tsamba ngati kufotokoza; mizati ina imakhala malo apadera. Ubale, zithunzi ndi zolumikizidwa sizilowetsedwa.
import-board-instruction-plane: Mu Plane, tsegulani Workspace Settings, sankhani Exports, tulutsani mapulojekiti ngati JSON, CSV kapena Excel ndipo tsitsani fayilo ya .zip, kenako sankhani fayiloyo, kapena fayilo imodzi yomwe ili mkati mwake, kapena matani JSON kapena CSV. Mikhalidwe imakhala mindandanda, mapulojekiti amakhala mizere yosambira, ndipo nkhani zimakhala makhadi pamodzi ndi chizindikiritso, kholo, owaperekera ntchito, zilembo, masiku, maulalo ndi ndemanga; zofunika kwambiri, kuyerekeza, cycle ndi module zimakhala malo apadera. Kutulutsa kwa Plane kulibe kufotokoza kapena zolumikizidwa, choncho sizilowetsedwa.
import-board-instruction-trello: Pa bolodi lanu la Trello, pitani ku 'Menu', kenako 'More', 'Print and Export', 'Export JSON', ndipo koperani mawu omwe atuluka.
import-board-instruction-csv: Matani apa mitengo yolekanitsidwa ndi koma (CSV) / mitengo yolekanitsidwa ndi tabu (TSV).
import-board-instruction-jira: Matani JSON yochokera ku kusaka ma issue kwa Jira Cloud REST API (GET /rest/api/3/search/jql), kapena chinthu chofanana cha { "issues": [...] }. Ma status a Jira amakhala mindandanda ndipo ma issue amakhala makhadi. Mungaphatikize mndandanda wa "automationRules" kuti mulowetse malamulo.

r-wrike-workflow-note: Kayendedwe ka ntchito ka Wrike ndi mndandanda wa mikhalidwe, uliwonse mu gulu la Active, Completed, Deferred kapena Cancelled. Kutulutsa kumalemba mindandanda ya bolodi ili ngati kamodzi, kotchedwa dzina la bolodi, mu JSON yomwe API ya Wrike imabweza pa kayendedwe ka ntchito: pangani kayendedwe kameneko mu Wrike musanalowetse kutulutsa kwa Wrike Excel kwa bolodi, kuti mikhalidwe yake igwiritsidwe ntchito. Kulowetsa kumawerenga JSON imeneyo yomatidwa pamwambapa, kuchokera ku WeKan kapena ku GET /workflows ya Wrike, mu bolodi losankhidwa: mkhalidwe wopanda mndandanda umakhala mndandanda, ndipo lamulo limasonyeza kuti khadi latha likasamutsidwira ku mkhalidwe wa Completed kapena Cancelled ndipo silinathe likakhala mu Active kapena Deferred. Malamulo a automation a Wrike sangathe kutulutsidwa mu Wrike.

globalSearch-instructions-description: Kusaka kungaphatikize ma operator kuti kulondole bwino. Ma operator amalembedwa polemba dzina la operator ndi mtengo wake zolekanitsidwa ndi colon. Mwachitsanzo, kulemba operator wa `list:Blocked` kungachepetse kusaka ku makhadi omwe ali mu mndandanda wotchedwa *Blocked*. Ngati mtengo uli ndi mipata kapena zilembo zapadera uyenera kuzunguliridwa ndi zizindikiro za mawu (mwachitsanzo `__operator_list__:"To Review"`).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-board: `__operator_board__:<title>` - makhadi a m'mabodi ofanana ndi *<title>* yomwe yalembedwa
globalSearch-instructions-operator-list: `__operator_list__:<title>` - makhadi a m'mindandanda yofanana ndi *<title>* yomwe yalembedwa
globalSearch-instructions-operator-swiml: `__operator_swimlane__:<title>` - makhadi a m'mizere yosambira yofanana ndi *<title>* yomwe yalembedwa
globalSearch-instructions-operator-comme: `__operator_comment__:<text>` - makhadi okhala ndi ndemanga yomwe ili ndi *<text>*.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-label: `__operator_label__:<color>` `__operator_label__:<name>` - makhadi okhala ndi chizindikiro chofanana ndi *<color>* kapena *<name>
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_creator__:<username>` - makhadi omwe *<username>* ndi amene anapanga khadi
globalSearch-instructions-operator-org: `__operator_org__:<display name|short name>` - makhadi a bolodi lopatsidwa ku bungwe la *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-team: `__operator_team__:<display name|short name>` - makhadi a bolodi lopatsidwa ku gulu la *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - makhadi omwe nthawi yawo yomalizira ili m'masiku *<n>* kuchokera pano. `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ imaonetsa makhadi onse omwe deti lawo lomalizira ladutsa.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - makhadi omwe anapangidwa masiku *<n>* apitawo kapena kucheperapo
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - makhadi omwe anasinthidwa masiku *<n>* apitawo kapena kucheperapo
globalSearch-instructions-status-public: `__predicate_public__` - makhadi a m'mabodi a anthu onse okha
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - pomwe *<field>* ndi chimodzi mwa `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` kapena `__predicate_member__`. Kuika `-` kutsogolo kwa *<field>* kumasaka kusakhalapo kwa mtengo m'malo amenewo (mwachitsanzo `has:-due` imasaka makhadi opanda deti lomalizira).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - pomwe *<sort-name>* ndi chimodzi mwa `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` kapena `__predicate_modified__`. Kuti musanje motsikira, ikani `-` kutsogolo kwa dzina la kasanjidwe.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - pomwe *<n>* ndi nambala yathunthu yoposa ziro yosonyeza chiwerengero cha makhadi oonetsedwa pa tsamba lililonse.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Ma operator ofanana amalumikizidwa ndi *OR*. Makhadi ofanana ndi chikhalidwe chilichonse adzabwezedwa.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` ingabweze makhadi a mu mndandanda uliwonse wotchedwa *Blocked* kapena *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Ma operator osiyana amalumikizidwa ndi *AND*. Makhadi okhawo ofanana ndi ma operator onse osiyanasiyana ndi amene amabwezedwa. `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` imabweza makhadi a mu mndandanda wa *Available* okhala ndi chizindikiro cha *red* okha.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Masiku angalembedwe ngati nambala yathunthu yoposa kapena yochepera ziro, kapena pogwiritsa ntchito `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` kapena `__predicate_year__` pa nthawi yapano.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-4: Kusaka mawu sikusiyanitsa zilembo zazikulu ndi zazing'ono.

database-migration-description: Samutsani data ya mawu (zonse kupatula zolumikizidwa ndi zithunzi za mbiri, zomwe zimakhalabe mu filesystem) pakati pa MongoDB ndi FerretDB v1 (SQLite). Nkhokwe ina ya data iyenera kukhala ikuyenda ndi kufikirika (ma port achizolowezi: FerretDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019; sinthani ndi WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL). Zikatha, lozani MONGO_URL ku nkhokwe ina ya data ndipo yambitsaninso WeKan (pa Snap: snap set wekan database=ferretdb kapena =mongodb).

sandstorm-migration-description: WeKan ikamayenda mkati mwa grain ya Sandstorm, nkhokwe yake yakale ya MongoDB 3 imasamutsidwa ku FerretDB v1 (SQLite) poyambitsa koyamba, ndipo zolumikizidwa ndi zithunzi za mbiri zimasunthidwa kuchokera mu nkhokwe ya data kupita m'mafoda a files/attachments ndi files/avatars a grain. Izi zimaonetsa ngati kusamutsako kunapambana ndi kuchuluka kwa malo a disiki omwe mafayilo akale osaphika a nkhokwe ya MongoDB akugwiritsabe ntchito mkati mwa grain, ndipo zimakulolani kufufuta mafayilo osaphikawo kuti mumasule malo.

card-field-visibility-desc: Malo a Zokonda za Bolodi / Khadi omwe mabolodi angathe kuonetsa. Malo osachongedwa amabisidwa pa khadi lililonse, kakhadi kakang'ono ndi Zokonda za Bolodi / Khadi za bolodi lililonse. Palibe deta ya khadi kapena zokonda za bolodi zomwe zimasintha, ndipo kuwachonganso kumaonetsa bolodi lililonse monga linakhazikitsidwira. Kalongosoledwe ka malo ndi ka bolodi lililonse palokha.
cards-loading-description: WeKan imatsegula makhadi a bolodi yokha: bolodi lalikulu (loposa malire a kukula) limatsegula makhadi omwe akuoneka pano okha (infinite scroll) limodzi ndi chiwerengero chamoyo, kuti likhalebe lachangu ndi kugwiritsa ntchito memory ndi bandwidth yochepa, pamene mabodi aang'ono amatsegula khadi lililonse kuti agwire ntchito zonse mosavuta. Palibe choti mukonze. Oyang'anira angakakamizebe njira ndi ma environment variable a CARDS_LOADING (all/lazy/auto) ndi CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Kutsegula makhadi kwa lazy kukuyesedwabe: ziwerengero za makhadi ndi malire a WIP ndi zolondola, koma maonekedwe a Kalendala/Tebulo/Gantt ndi kusankha zambiri amaonetsa makhadi omwe atsegulidwa mpaka pano okha. Tsegulaninso mabodi otseguka mutasintha izi.
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Izi zikayatsidwa, maulalo onse (maulalo a markdown monga [chizindikiro](url) ndi ma tag osaphika a HTML a <a href>) nthawi zonse amaonetsedwa ngati mawu wamba osadinika m'malo onse a mawu olemera (mitu ya bolodi ndi khadi, mafotokozedwe, ndemanga, mindandanda yowunika, ndi zina). Izi zimaletsa maulalo odinika osocheretsa. Mwachizolowezi zimakhala zozimitsidwa, choncho maulalo amakhalabe odinika.
always-show-code-as-text: Nthawi zonse onetsani code yonse ngati mawu wamba
always-show-code-as-text-description: Izi zikayatsidwa, mawu olemera sapangidwa ngati markdown kapena HTML: gwero lonse nthawi zonse limaonetsedwa ngati mawu wamba m'malo onse a mawu olemera (mitu ya bolodi ndi khadi, mafotokozedwe, ndemanga, mindandanda yowunika, ndi zina). Izi zimaulula zinthu zobisika — ndemanga za HTML (<!-- -->), komwe maulalo a markdown akuloza, JavaScript ndi code ina iliyonse — kuti code yonse izioneka nthawi zonse, isadinike, ndiponso isamayende. Mwachizolowezi zimakhala zozimitsidwa, choncho markdown imapangidwa mwachizolowezi.
disable-all-import-description: Izi zikayatsidwa, njira zonse zolowetsera zimazimitsidwa: kulowetsa bolodi kuchokera ku WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea ndi Forgejo, komanso kubwereza bolodi. Zosankha zolowetsera mu menyu zimabisidwa ndipo seva imakana pempho lililonse lolowetsa. Mwachizolowezi zimakhala zozimitsidwa.
disable-all-export-description: Izi zikayatsidwa, njira zonse zotumizira zimazimitsidwa: kutumiza bolodi ngati WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, kapena ku NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, ndi kutumiza cholumikizidwa chimodzi. Zosankha zotumizira mu menyu zimabisidwa ndipo seva imakana pempho lililonse lotumiza. Mwachizolowezi zimakhala zozimitsidwa.
disable-import-avatars-description: Izi zikayatsidwa, zithunzi za mbiri za ogwiritsa ntchito sizilowetsedwa konse. Izi zikuphatikiza kulowetsa kwa WeKan JSON, kulowetsa kwa Trello, ndi kugwirizanitsa zithunzi kuchokera kwa opereka chizindikiritso akunja polowa (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Mayina ndi data ina zimalowetsedwabe; zithunzi za mbiri zokha ndi zimene zimalumphidwa. Mwachizolowezi zimakhala zozimitsidwa.
disable-export-avatars-description: Izi zikayatsidwa, zithunzi za mbiri siziphatikizidwa konse potumiza bolodi (kutumiza kwa WeKan JSON ndi CSV). Mayina a ogwiritsa ntchito ndi data ina zimatumizidwabe; zithunzi za mbiri zokha ndi zimene zimasiyidwa. Mwachizolowezi zimakhala zozimitsidwa.

anonymize-account: Bisani zizindikiritso za ogwiritsa ntchito olowetsedwa
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Izi zikayatsidwa, kutumiza bolodi kumalowetsa dzina la wogwiritsa ntchito, dzina lonse ndi zilembo zoyambira za aliyense ndi zosungira malo zowerengedwa (wogwiritsa1, wogwiritsa2, ...), kumachotsa chithunzi chake cha mbiri, ndi kulembanso matchulidwe a @username (ndi malo a requested-by / assigned-by) mkati mwa zomwe zili mu khadi ndi ndemanga. disable-activities-description: Izi zikayatsidwa, zolemba za nkhani za zochitika sizilembedwa ndipo sizionetsedwa kulikonse (bala lam'mbali la bolodi ndi tabu ya zochitika za khadi). Palibe mbiri ya amene anachita chiyani yomwe imasungidwa. Mwachizolowezi zimakhala zozimitsidwa.
disable-notifications-description: Izi zikayatsidwa, WeKan situmiza zidziwitso zoyang'anira (mkati mwa pulogalamu, imelo kapena ntchito zina) pa chochita chilichonse. Zochitika zingalembedwabe (kupatula ngati nazonso zazimitsidwa pamwambapa); zidziwitso zokha ndi zimene zimaletsedwa. Mwachizolowezi zimakhala zozimitsidwa.
disable-watch-description: Izi zikayatsidwa, kuyang'anira kumazimitsidwa — ogwiritsa ntchito sangathe kulembetsa ku mabodi, mindandanda kapena makhadi kuti alandire zidziwitso, ndipo kuyesa kulikonse kosintha mulingo wa kuyang'anira kumakanidwa. Mwachizolowezi zimakhala zozimitsidwa.
backup-description: Sungani zobwezeretsera za Zolumikizidwa, Zithunzi za mbiri ndi/kapena Data (ma collection onse a mawu omwe si zolumikizidwa kapena zithunzi za mbiri). Fayilo ya .zip imatumizidwa mwachindunji ku chosungira chosankhidwa — popanda fayilo yakanthawi — ngati backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, yokhala ndi YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars ndi /data. Zosungira za mtambo (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) zimagwiritsa ntchito zitsimikizo zokonzedwa m'matabu awo osungira.
backup-scope-description: Instance yonse, kapena Bungwe limodzi. Zosunga zobwezeretsera za Bungwe zimakhala ndi mabodi ake ndi zonse zomwe zili pamenepo, kuphatikiza zolumikizidwa za mabodiwo — koma popanda ma akaunti a ogwiritsa ntchito ndi zokonda za instance, chifukwa zimagawidwa ndi Bungwe lililonse. Kubwezeretsa zosunga za Bungwe kumangolemba pa mabodi omwe Bungwelo lili nawo.
theme-override-all-tenants: Kusintha komwe kumagwira ntchito kwa alendi onse
continuous-backup-description: Kumatumiza kusintha kulikonse kwa nkhokwe ya data, zolumikizidwa, zithunzi za mbiri ndi zolemba za zochitika ku foda m'masekondi ochepa, kuti data ibwezeretsedwe mmene inalili pa nthawi iliyonse. Kumagwira ntchito limodzi ndi kusunga zobwezeretsera kokonzedwera nthawi, komwe kumapanga zosunga zonse.
continuous-backup-enabled: Yambitsani kusunga zobwezeretsera mosalekeza pa seva iyi
continuous-backup-target: Foda yopita (njira yonse pa disiki ina, malo ogawana pa netiweki kapena malo olumikizidwa ndi rclone)
continuous-backup-engine-sqlite: Masamba a SQLite (masamba omwe asintha pa nthawi iliyonse)
continuous-backup-engine-none: Palibe injini ya nkhokwe ya data yomwe ingagwire ntchito pa seva iyi
continuous-backup-sqlite-interval: Nthawi pakati pa kufufuza kwa SQLite (masekondi)
continuous-backup-key-file: Fayilo ya kiyi yobisa ndi khodi (njira yonse kunja kwa foda yopita; zilembo 64 za manambala oyambira pa 16 kapena mawu achinsinsi okhala ndi zilembo zosachepera 16). Sungani kopi: popanda iyo, zosunga zobwezeretsera sizingabwezeretsedwe.
continuous-backup-restore-sqlite: Fayilo ya nkhokwe ya data ya SQLite (imapangidwa pafupi ndi zosunga zobwezeretsera, silemba konse pamwamba pa fayilo yomwe ikugwiritsidwa ntchito)
continuous-backup-apply-on-restart: Gwiritsani ntchito nkhokwe ya data ya SQLite yomangidwanso pa kuyambitsanso kotsatira (nkhokwe yakale yomwe yasinthidwa idzasungidwa)
continuous-backup-restore-confirm: Bwezeretsani mbadwo wosankhidwa mmene unalili pa nthawi yosankhidwa? Kusunga zobwezeretsera mosalekeza kudzayima kaye pamene kubwezeretsa kukuchitika.
continuous-backup-saved: Zokonda za kusunga zobwezeretsera mosalekeza zasungidwa
backup-restore-select-first: Sankhani kaye zosunga zobwezeretsera pa mndandanda.
backup-restore-confirm: Bwezeretsani zosunga zobwezeretsera zosankhidwa? Zolumikizidwa/zithunzi za mbiri zimalembedwa mu dongosolo la mafayilo ndipo data imalembedwa mu nkhokwe ya data motsatira njira yosankhidwa.
gcs-key-filename: Njira ya fayilo ya kiyi ya akaunti ya ntchito
gcs-key-filename-description: Zosankha: njira yopita ku fayilo ya kiyi ya JSON ya akaunti ya ntchito pa seva.
gcs-credentials-description: Zosankha: matani kiyi ya JSON ya akaunti ya ntchito. Siyani mopanda kanthu kuti mugwiritse ntchito fayilo ya kiyi kapena zitsimikizo zachizolowezi.
gcs-permissions-note: Patsani akaunti ya ntchito ya WeKan mwayi wowerenga/kulemba mu ndowa: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → ndowa yanu → Permissions → Grant access. Mu "New principals", matani imelo ya akaunti ya ntchito — mtengo wa "client_email" kuchokera mu kiyi yanu ya JSON — kenako sankhani udindo wa "Storage Object Admin" ndi Save.
cloud-secret-keep-blank: Siyani mopanda kanthu kuti musunge mtengo wapano.
azure-account-name-description: Dzina la akaunti yanu ya Azure Storage.
gcs-project-id-description: ID ya pulojekiti yanu ya Google Cloud.
gcs-bucket-description: Dzina la ndowa ya Cloud Storage yosungiramo mafayilo.
s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: siyani mopanda kanthu (imagwiritsa ntchito endpoint ya region). Yogwirizana ndi S3: Endpoint URL kuchokera mu console yanu ya MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / Backblaze B2 / Wasabi / DigitalOcean Spaces.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → ndowa yanu → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → dzina la ndowa yanu (kapena Create bucket → Bucket name).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Users → wogwiritsa ntchito wanu → Security credentials → Access keys → Create access key → sankhani use case ya 'Application running outside AWS' → Create access key. Imaonetsedwa ngati 'Access key ID'.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: Sikirini yomweyo ya Access key ID; 'Secret access key' imaonetsedwa kamodzi kokha kiyi ikapangidwa — koperani nthawi imeneyo (kapena Download .csv).
azure-account-name-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akaunti yanu → dzina lomwe likuoneka pamwamba (komanso pansi pa Security + networking → Access keys → Storage account name).
azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akaunti yanu → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Show → Key.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akaunti yanu → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → Show.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akaunti yanu → Data storage → Containers → container yanu (kapena + Container kuti mupange).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → chosankhira pulojekiti pamwamba → ID ya pulojekiti yanu (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → dzina la ndowa yanu (kapena Create kuti mupange).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: Njira pa seva ya WeKan yopita ku fayilo ya kiyi ya JSON ya akaunti ya ntchito yomwe yatsitsidwa (yopangidwa pansipa). Gwiritsani ntchito izi KAPENA matani JSON mu malo ali pansipa.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → IAM & Admin → Service accounts → akaunti yanu ya ntchito → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON → Create (imatsitsa fayilo). Matani zomwe zili mufayiloyo apa, kapena sungani fayiloyo ndi kukhazikitsa njira yake pamwambapa.
attachment-move-storage-azure: Sunthani cholumikizidwa kupita ku Azure Blob Storage
attachment-move-storage-gcs: Sunthani cholumikizidwa kupita ku Google Cloud Storage
gridfs-enabled-description: Gwiritsani ntchito MongoDB GridFS posungira mafayilo
migration-stop-confirm: Kodi mukutsimikiza kuti mukufuna kuyimitsa kusamutsa konse?
gridfs-move-collectionfs-note: Kuti zolumikizidwa ndi zithunzi za mbiri zioneke, zisuntheni kuchokera ku CollectionFS kupita ku chosungira china chilichonse.
s3-access-key-description: Kiyi yolowera ya AWS S3 yotsimikizira
s3-bucket-description: Dzina la bucket ya S3 yosungiramo mafayilo
s3-enabled-description: Gwiritsani ntchito AWS S3 kapena MinIO posungira mafayilo

s3-port-description: Nambala ya doko la endpoint ya S3
s3-secret-key-description: Kiyi yachinsinsi ya AWS S3 yotsimikizira

comprehensive-board-migration-descriptio: Kumachita kuwunika ndi kukonza kwathunthu kwa kukhulupirika kwa data ya bolodi, kuphatikiza dongosolo la mindandanda, malo a makhadi ndi kapangidwe ka mizere yosambira.
delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migration-d: Kumafufuta mosamala mindandanda yobwereza yopanda kanthu. Kumangochotsa mindandanda yomwe ilibe makhadi NDIPO ili ndi mndandanda wina wa mutu womwewo wokhala ndi makhadi.
restore-lost-cards-migration-description: Kumapeza ndi kubwezeretsa makhadi ndi mindandanda yomwe ikusowa swimlaneId kapena listId. Kumapanga mzere wosambira wa 'Makhadi otayika' kuti zinthu zonse zotayika zionekenso.
restore-all-archived-migration-descripti: Kumabwezeretsa mizere yosambira, mindandanda ndi makhadi onse osungidwa. Kumakonza kokha swimlaneId kapena listId iliyonse yosowa kuti zinthu zioneke.
fix-missing-lists-migration-description: Kumazindikira ndi kukonza mindandanda yosowa kapena yowonongeka mu kapangidwe ka bolodi.
fix-avatar-urls-migration: Konzani ma URL a zithunzi za mbiri
fix-avatar-urls-migration-description: Kumasintha ma URL a zithunzi za mbiri za mamembala a bolodi kuti agwiritse ntchito chosungira cholondola ndi kukonza maumboni osweka a zithunzi.
fix-all-file-urls-migration: Konzani ma URL onse a mafayilo
fix-all-file-urls-migration-description: Kumasintha ma URL onse a mafayilo olumikizidwa pa bolodi ili kuti agwiritse ntchito chosungira cholondola ndi kukonza maumboni osweka a mafayilo.
migrations-admin-only: Oyang'anira bolodi okha ndi amene angayendetse kusamutsa

run-delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migrati: Izi ziyamba ndi kusintha mindandanda yogawana kukhala mindandanda ya mzere uliwonse wosambira, kenako kufufuta mindandanda yopanda kanthu yomwe ili ndi mndandanda wobwereza wa mutu womwewo wokhala ndi makhadi. Mindandanda yopanda kanthu yosafunika kwenikweni yokha ndi imene idzachotsedwa. Pitirizani?
run-restore-lost-cards-migration-confirm: Izi zipanga mzere wosambira wa 'Makhadi otayika' ndi kubwezeretsa makhadi ndi mindandanda yonse yomwe ikusowa swimlaneId kapena listId. Zimakhudza zinthu zosasungidwa zokha. Pitirizani?
run-restore-all-archived-migration-confi: Izi zibwezeretsa mizere yosambira, mindandanda ndi makhadi ONSE osungidwa kuti zionekenso. Zinthu zilizonse zomwe zikusowa ma ID zidzakonzedwa zokha. Izi sizingabwezedwe mosavuta. Pitirizani?
run-fix-missing-lists-migration-confirm: Izi zizindikira ndi kukonza mindandanda yosowa kapena yowonongeka mu kapangidwe ka bolodi. Pitirizani?
run-fix-avatar-urls-migration-confirm: Izi zisintha ma URL a zithunzi za mbiri za mamembala a bolodi kuti agwiritse ntchito chosungira cholondola. Pitirizani?
run-fix-all-file-urls-migration-confirm: Izi zisintha ma URL onse a mafayilo olumikizidwa pa bolodi ili kuti agwiritse ntchito chosungira cholondola. Pitirizani?

migration-progress-note: Chonde dikirani pamene tikusamutsa bolodi lanu kupita ku kapangidwe katsopano kwambiri...

step-fix-avatar-urls: Konzani ma URL a zithunzi za mbiri
step-ensure-lost-cards-swimlane: Onetsetsani mzere wosambira wa Makhadi otayika

conversion-info-text: Kusintha uku kumachitika kamodzi pa bolodi lililonse ndipo kumathandiza kagwiridwe ntchito. Mungapitirize kugwiritsa ntchito bolodi mwachizolowezi.
converting-board-description: Kusintha kapangidwe ka bolodi kuti ligwire ntchito bwino. Izi zingatenge kanthawi.
migrate-all-to-filesystem: Samutsani zonse ku dongosolo la mafayilo
migration-batch-size-description: Chiwerengero cha zolumikizidwa zogwiritsidwa ntchito mu gulu lililonse (1-100)
migration-cpu-threshold-description: Imitsani kaye kusamutsa ngati kugwiritsa ntchito CPU kwadutsa peresenti iyi (10-90)
migration-delay-ms-description: Kuchedwa pakati pa magulu mu ma millisecond (100-10000)
migration-info-text: Kusamutsa nkhokwe ya data kumachitika kamodzi ndipo kumathandiza kagwiridwe ka dongosolo. Ntchitoyi imapitiriza kumbuyo ngakhale mutatseka browser yanu.
migration-warning-text: Chonde musatseke browser yanu pamene kusamutsa kukuyenda. Ntchitoyi idzapitiriza kumbuyo koma ingatenge nthawi yaitali kuti ithe.
showChecklistAtMinicard: Onetsani mndandanda wowunika pa khadi laling'ono
account-locked: Akaunti yatsekedwa kwakanthawi chifukwa cha zoyesa kulowa zolephera zambiri. Chonde yesaninso pambuyo pake.
invalid-credentials: Dzina la wogwiritsa ntchito kapena mawu achinsinsi ndi osalondola
username-password-required: Dzina la wogwiritsa ntchito ndi mawu achinsinsi zikufunika
username-too-short: Dzina la wogwiritsa ntchito liyenera kukhala ndi zilembo 3 kapena kuposerapo
problems-summary-help: Chongani madera a mavuto omwe mwaunikanso, kenako dinani Vomerezani kuti mukhazikitsenso chiwerengero cha mavuto atsopano.
problems-in-progress-help: Kusamutsa kapena kukonza uku kukuyenda pano. Kulowa kungakhale kochedwa, kapena kuonetsa chizindikiro chozungulira cha "Muyenera kukhala mwalowa" kapena "Kutsegula, chonde dikirani", mpaka zitatha ndipo CPU itsike.
problems-none-in-progress: Palibe kusamutsa kapena kukonza komwe kukuyenda.
repair-broken-cards-done-unfixable: Makhadi __fixed__ akonzedwa. Makhadi __unfixable__ alibe bolodi ndipo sangathe kukonzedwa okha.
export-card-details: Tsatanetsatane wa khadi (khadi lililonse monga potumiza khadi)

date-range-of-fields: Gawo la tsiku la minda yapadera yolembedwa kuti isonyezedwe pamwamba pa mndandanda
twoFactorAuth-enabled: Kutsimikizira kwa njira ziwiri kwayambitsidwa pa akaunti yanu.
twoFactorAuth-explanation: Onjezani chitetezo chowonjezera pa akaunti yanu. Mukayambitsa, muyenera kulowetsa nambala yochokera pa pulogalamu yotsimikizira nthawi iliyonse mukalowa.
twoFactorAuth-scan-instructions: Sinthani khodi ya QR iyi ndi pulogalamu yotsimikizira (mwachitsanzo, Google Authenticator, Authy), kenako lowetsani nambala ya 6-digit yomwe ikuwonetsedwa kuti mutsimikize.
twoFactorCode-invalid: Nambala yotsimikizira si yoyenera. Chonde yesaninso.

subtask-done-no-permission: Simungasinthe ngati kantchito aka katha kapena ayi
chart-forecast-none-remaining: Palibe chotsala choti mupenyerere - kadi iliyonse yatha.
chart-forecast-no-velocity: Pali makadi __remaining__ omwe adakalipobe otseguka; palibe zomaliza posachedwa zoti mupenyerere tsiku.
chart-forecast-projected: Pa liwiro la posachedwa la makadi __average__ pa sabata, makadi __remaining__ omwe akalipo otseguka ayenera kutha pofika __date__.
list-sync-description: Sungani mndandanda uwu wamakono kuchokera ku chowunikira chakunja. Ntchito yakuseri imayang'ana mphindi 15 zilizonse; gwiritsani ntchito "Gwirizanitsani tsopano" kuti muwunikire nthawi yomweyo.
drag-to-reorder: Kokani kuti musinthe dongosolo. Mabatani a mivi yokwera ndi yotsika amasuntha malo amodzi.
map-view-empty: Bolodi ili lilibe chithunzi cha mapu panopa. Woyang'anira bolodi angakweze chithunzi — pulani yosonyeza zipinda za nyumba, mapu a malo kapena chojambula — ndipo makhadi angayikidwe pamwamba pake.
map-view-place-hint: Kokerani khadi pa mapu, kapena lisankheni kenako dinani pamalo ake.
flow-note-agingWip: Mndandanda: Yambani → Kutalika kwa nthawi. P85: n ≥ 5. (sichikudziwika): —.
flow-note-monteCarlo: Monte Carlo: 2000 × Mbiri. masiku: UTC; 0 ✓. 50%, 70%, 85%, 95%. Makhadi ≥; Kutalika kwa nthawi ≤. Malire: 3650 masiku.
flow-note-processBehavior: XmR: Nthawi ya kuzungulira; Yambani → Zamalizidwa. n ≥ 2. X: x̄ ± 3 × MR̄ / 1.128; MR: 0…3.267 × MR̄.
flow-note-sizeCycleTime: X: Planning Poker / Nambala. Y: Nthawi ya kuzungulira (masiku). (sichikudziwika): —.
time-adjustment-note: Mbiri: Δ maola; Dzina logwiritsa ntchito ≠ Operekedwa ntchito.
blockly-ARIA_LABEL_TRASH_EMPTY: Dengu la zinyalala, palibe kanthu panopa
blockly-CANNOT_DELETE_VARIABLE_PROCEDURE: Sitingathe kuchotsa chosinthika '%1' chifukwa ndi gawo la tanthauzo la funkishoni '%2'
blockly-COLOUR_BLEND_TOOLTIP: Amasakaniza mitundu iwiri pamodzi ndi chiŵerengero choperekedwa (0.0 - 1.0).
blockly-COLOUR_PICKER_TOOLTIP: Sankhani mtundu pa mitundu yomwe ilipo.
blockly-COLOUR_RGB_TOOLTIP: Pangani mtundu wokhala ndi kuchuluka kotchulidwa kwa wofiira, wobiriwira ndi wabuluu. Mitengo yonse iyenera kukhala pakati pa 0 ndi 100.
blockly-CONTROLS_FLOW_STATEMENTS_OPERATO: pitirizani ndi kubwereza kotsatira kwa lupu
blockly-CONTROLS_FLOW_STATEMENTS_TOOLTIP: Tulukani mu lupu yomwe ili nazo.

blockly-CONTROLS_FLOW_STATEMENTS_WARNING: Chenjezo: Chipika ichi chingagwiritsidwe ntchito mkati mwa lupu yokha.
blockly-CONTROLS_FOREACH_TOOLTIP: Pa chinthu chilichonse mu mndandanda, ikani chosinthika '%1' kukhala chinthucho, kenako chitani malangizo ena.
blockly-CONTROLS_FOR_TOOLTIP: Lolani chosinthika '%1' kutenga mitengo kuchokera ku nambala yoyambira mpaka nambala yomaliza, kuwerenga ndi kudumpha kotchulidwa, ndipo chitani zipika zotchulidwa.
blockly-CONTROLS_IF_ELSEIF_TOOLTIP: Onjezani mkhalidwe ku chipika cha ngati.
blockly-CONTROLS_IF_ELSE_TOOLTIP: Onjezani mkhalidwe womaliza wogwira zonse ku chipika cha ngati.
blockly-CONTROLS_IF_IF_TOOLTIP: Onjezani, chotsani, kapena sinthani dongosolo la zigawo kuti mukonzenso chipika cha ngati ichi.
blockly-CONTROLS_IF_TOOLTIP_1: Ngati mtengo uli woona, chitani malangizo ena.

sync-estimate-field-gitlab-hint: Kulemera kapena chiyerekezo cha nthawi cha GitLab chimalembedwa mu malo a manambala amene mwasankha. Zosintha za pano zimawunikidwa ngati mikangano; nkhani yopanda kulemera imachotsa mtengo wolumikizidwa.
email-recovery-description: Mzere umodzi pa wolandira aliyense. Sakani ndi ID ya wogwiritsa ntchito. Zomwe zili mu uthenga ndi malo a imelo ya wolandira sizionetsedwa. Kuimitsa kaye kumasunga mauthenga omwe alipo ndi omwe adzabwere; Kupitiriza kumayesanso kutumiza mauthenga omwe ali pamzere panopa. Kuletsa kumachotsa mauthenga omwe anaikidwa pamzere mpaka nthawi ya pempho. Ngati kutumiza kuli pa ntchito, yesaninso pakapita nthawi yochepa. Uthenga womwe wayamba kale kutumizidwa sungabwezedwe, ndipo kutumiza komwe zotsatira zake sizikudziwika kungabwerezedwe. Zolephera zokhalitsa ndi mauthenga omwe afika pa malire oyesanso zimakhalabe kuti ziwunikidwe. Kuyesanso mauthenga omwe analephera kumayamba gawo latsopano la kuyesa ndipo kumasunga kuimitsidwa kaye komwe kulipo.
email-recovery-empty: Palibe mauthenga pamzere ndipo palibe olandira omwe kutumiza kwaimitsidwa kaye.
email-recovery-unavailable: Sitingawerenge mzere wa maimelo. Onani zilolezo za woyang'anira ndi ngati seva ikupezeka.
email-recovery-busy: Kutumiza kapena ntchito ina ya pamzere ikuchitika. Sinthani zimene zikuonetsedwa ndipo yesaninso pakapita nthawi yochepa.
email-recovery-failed: Ntchitoyo sinatsimikizidwe. Sinthani zimene zikuonetsedwa pamzere ndipo yesaninso ntchito yomweyo ngati kuli kofunikira.
email-recovery-superseded: Ntchito yatsopano ya woyendetsa ntchito yalowa m'malo mwa pempholi. Mkhalidwe wa mzere wa panopa ukuonetsedwa.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Muletse mauthenga onse omwe ali pamzere panopa a wolandira uyu? Zomwe zili m'mauthengawo zichotsedwa ndipo sizingabwezeretsedwe. Mauthenga atsopano omwe apangidwa pambuyo pa pempholi adzasungidwa.
sync-time-estimate-hint: Kuyerekeza kwa nthawi kumagwiritsa ntchito malo a nambala a nthawi yoyambirira/yotsala opangidwa ndi kulowetsa kwa Jira. Malo amodzi ndendende ofanana ayenera kukhalapo pa bolodi ili. Zosintha za pano zimawunikidwa ngati kusemphana; mitengo yochokera yosowa imanyalanyazidwa ndipo null yotchulidwa imafufuta mtengo.
sync-planning-hint: Sprint ndi zotulutsidwa zimagwirizanitsidwa pokhapokha Scrum yayatsidwa pa bolodi ili. Sprint kapena chotulutsidwa chosowa chimapangidwa pa bolodi ili, ndi masiku operekedwa ndi kochokera; chomwe chilipo kale chimafananitsidwa kaye ndi ID yake yochokera, kenako ndi dzina. Kusintha kwa kukonzekera kwa pano kumakhalabe mpaka kochokera kusinthe kukonzekera kwa nkhani imeneyo, ndipo Sync yoyamba sichotsa kukonzekera.
activity-recovery-description: Zidziwitso zosamalizidwa zimayesedwanso zokha. Wunikani zochitika zosowa kapena zosinthidwa musanayesenso. Kuyesanso sikupanganso chochitika.
activity-recovery-unavailable: Sitinathe kutsitsa zidziwitso za zochitika zodikira.
activity-recovery-busy: Wogwira ntchito wina akusamalira chidziwitso ichi. Tsitsaninso ndipo yesaninso.
activity-recovery-denied: Chilolezo cha wolandira kapena zokonda za zidziwitso sizilolanso kutumiza.
activity-recovery-source-unavailable: Chochitika choyambirira chikusowa kapena chasintha. Palibe chomwe chapangidwanso.
activity-recovery-failed: Sitinathe kumaliza kutumiza chidziwitso. Ntchito yodikira yasungidwa.
activity-recovery-paused: Kutumiza zidziwitso za zochitika kwayimitsidwa kaye.
activity-recovery-control-conflict: Chidziwitso ichi chasintha kuchokera pamene chinatsitsidwa. Wunikani mkhalidwe watsopano musanayesenso.
activity-recovery-control-failed: Sitinathe kutsimikizira zokonda za kutumiza. Tsitsaninso ndipo wunikani mkhalidwe wake wapano.
activity-recovery-cancel-confirm: Lekani kwamuyaya kutumiza kotsala kwa chochitika ichi? Izi sizingapitirizidwe. Imelo yomwe ili kale pa mzere ndi zidziwitso zotumizidwa kale sizibwezedwa.
rule-email-recovery-description: Unikaninso zoyesera zotumiza maimelo a malamulo zomwe zalembedwa. Zoyesera zosatsimikizidwa zingakhale zikutumizabe kapena zinadukizidwa. Lipotili silitumizanso maimelo kapena kuletsa kutumiza.
rule-email-recovery-empty: Palibe zoyesera zotumiza maimelo a malamulo zomwe zikugwirizana ndi kusakaku.
rule-email-recovery-unavailable: Sitinathe kutsitsa kuyesa kwa imelo za malamulo. Tsitsaninso kuti muyesenso.
rule-email-recovery-actions-hint: WeKan situmizanso yokha imelo yosatsimikizidwa. Kutumizanso kumapita kwa olandira osatsimikizidwa okha. Ikani chizindikiro chakuti yatumizidwa ngati mukudziwa kuti yafika, kapena letsani kutumiza.
rule-email-recovery-wait: Kutumiza koyambirira kungakhale kukuchitikabe. Mutha kusankha pambuyo pa __time__.
rule-email-recovery-resend-confirm: Mutumizenso imelo iyi kwa olandira osatsimikizidwa? Aliyense amene seva yake ya imelo inalandira uthengawo popanda kudziwitsa WeKan adzaulandira kawiri.
rule-email-recovery-mark-sent-confirm: Muyike chizindikiro chakuti imelo iyi yatumizidwa kwa onse? Chitani izi pokhapokha ngati mukudziwa kuti yafika.
rule-email-recovery-drop-confirm: Muletse kutumiza imelo iyi? Sidzatumizidwa kwa olandira osatsimikizidwa.
rule-email-resolution-too-early: Kutumiza koyambirira kungakhale kukuchitikabe. Yesaninso nthawi ina.
rule-email-resolution-resend-in-flight: Kutumizanso kwapitako kungakhale kukuchitikabe. Yesaninso nthawi ina.
rule-email-resolution-nothing-to-resend: Olandira onse atsimikizidwa kale. M'malo mwake, ikani chizindikiro chakuti yatumizidwa.
rule-email-resolution-resend-uncertain: Seva ya imelo sinayankhe. Uthenga wotumizidwanso ukhoza kukhala wafika kapena sunafike; ukuwonetsedwa ngati ukutumizidwabe.
rule-email-resolution-busy: Woyang'anira wina akuthetsa imelo iyi. Yesaninso posachedwa.
rule-email-resolution-command-changed: Imelo yosungidwa sikugwirizananso ndi kuyesaku, choncho siyingathetsedwe pano.
rule-email-resolution-attempt-invalid: Mbiri yosungidwa ya kuyesaku ndi yosavomerezeka, choncho siyingathetsedwe pano.
rule-email-resolution-failed: Imelo iyi sinathe kuthetsedwa. Tsitsimutsani tsamba ndi kuyesanso.
rule-email-legacy-description: Maimelo a malamulo awa anakonzedwa ndi mtundu wakale wa WeKan umene sunalembe kumene zomwe zili m'maimelowo zinachokera, choncho WeKan sidzawatumiza yokha. Mutayang'ana kuti wolemba lamulo akadali ndi chilolezo cholowa, lumikizaninso imelo kuti ikonzedwenso kuchokera pa mmene khadi lilili tsopano, kapena itayeni.
rule-email-legacy-reason-details-snapsho: Tsatanetsatane wa khadi wochokera ku mtundu wakale
rule-email-legacy-rebind-confirm: Mukonzenso imelo iyi kuchokera pa mmene khadi lilili tsopano? Zomwe zili mmenemo zingasiyane ndi zomwe zinakonzedwa kale.
rule-email-legacy-empty: Palibe maimelo a malamulo akudikira kuunikidwa.
rule-email-legacy-unavailable: Maimelo a malamulo akudikira kuunikidwa sanathe kutsegulidwa. Tsitsimutsani tsamba kuti muyesenso.
rule-email-legacy-access-denied: Wolemba lamulo alibenso chilolezo cholowa pa khadi ili, kapena lamulo lasintha, choncho imelo siyingalumikizidwenso. Mutha kuitaya.
rule-email-legacy-source-changed: Zochitika zimene zinayambitsa imelo iyi zasintha, choncho siyingalumikizidwenso. Mutha kuitaya.
rule-email-legacy-source-unavailable: Khadi limene imelo iyi inachokera silikupezekanso, choncho siyingalumikizidwenso. Mutha kuitaya.
rule-email-legacy-plan-unavailable: Kuchitika kwa lamulo kumene kunakonza imelo iyi sikunasungidwenso, choncho siyingalumikizidwenso. Mutha kuitaya.
rule-email-legacy-attempt-exists: Imelo iyi yatumizidwa kale, ayesa kale kuitumiza, kapena yatayidwa.
rule-email-legacy-failed: Ntchitoyi sinathe kumalizidwa. Tsitsimutsani tsamba ndi kuyesanso.
stuck-sync-operation-heading: Ntchito za List Sync zomwe sizingachitidwenso
stuck-sync-operation-description: Iliyonse mwa ntchito za List Sync zosungidwa izi inayima pakati ndipo siingathenso kumalizidwa, chifukwa mndandanda wake unachotsedwa, unapangidwanso kapena unakonzedwanso, kapena wogwiritsa ntchito amene anaiyambitsa analandidwa chilolezo cholemba. Pamene imodzi ikudikira, mndandanda umenewo sungathe kuchita Sync. Itayeni kuti mndandanda uchitenso Sync: zosintha zomwe zachitika kale zimakhalabe, zosintha zosungidwa zotsala sizilembedwa, ndipo Sync yotsatira imafananitsanso mndandanda ndi kochokera kwake.
stuck-sync-operation-reason-scope-change: Mndandanda unachotsedwa, unapangidwanso kapena zokonda zake za Sync zinasintha
stuck-sync-operation-reason-access-denie: Wogwiritsa ntchito amene anaiyambitsa alibenso chilolezo cholemba pa mndandanda wonse
stuck-sync-operation-reason-trigger-unkn: Inasungidwa ndi mtundu wakale wa WeKan popanda chomwe chinaiyambitsa
stuck-sync-operation-replayable-now: Ikhoza kuchitidwanso tsopano ndipo idzatha yokha, choncho singatayidwe.
stuck-sync-operation-discard-confirm: Tayani ntchito iyi ya List Sync yosungidwa? Zosintha zomwe yachita kale zimakhalabe; zotsalazo sizilembedwa. Mndandanda ungathe kuchitanso Sync pambuyo pake.
stuck-sync-operation-empty: Palibe ntchito za List Sync zomwe zikudikira kuwunikidwa.
stuck-sync-operation-truncated: Zakale kwambiri 50 zokha ndi zomwe zikuonetsedwa. Tayani zina ndipo tsitsaninso kuti muone zina.
stuck-sync-operation-unavailable: Sitinathe kutsitsa ntchito za List Sync. Tsitsaninso kuti muyesenso.
stuck-sync-operation-not-stuck: Ntchito iyi sinapezeke kuti yakakamira, choncho singatayidwe.
stuck-sync-operation-replayable: Ntchito iyi ikhoza kuchitidwanso tsopano ndipo idzatha yokha, choncho siinatayidwe.
stuck-sync-operation-busy: Mndandanda uwu ukuchita Sync pakali pano. Yesaninso pakapita kanthawi.
stuck-sync-operation-failed: Ntchitoyi sinathe kumalizidwa. Tsitsimutsani tsamba ndi kuyesanso.
interrupted-import-description: Kulowetsa mabolodi kulikonse kumeneku kunayima pakati - seva inayambitsidwanso, kapena kulowetsa kunalephera - ndipo kunasiya bolodi losakwanira. Kulowetsa sikungapitirizidwe, chifukwa fayilo yake yochokera sisungidwa. Sungani bolodi monga lilili, kapena litayeni ndipo lowetsaninso fayiloyo. Kutaya kumachotsa bolodi lomwe kulowetsa uku kunapanga ndi zonse zomwe zili pamenepo, kuphatikizapo chilichonse chomwe chawonjezedwa kuyambira pamenepo.
interrupted-import-scrum: Gawo lake la Scrum lili ndi pothera pake (__state__, masitepe __next__ mwa __total__). Ngati musunga bolodi, malizani kapena litayeni kuchokera ku kubwezeretsa kulowetsa kwa Scrum kwa bolodi.
interrupted-import-counts: mizere yosambira __swimlanes__, mindandanda __lists__, makhadi __cards__, mindandanda yowunika __checklists__, ndemanga __comments__, zolumikizidwa __attachments__
interrupted-import-keep-confirm: Sungani bolodi losakwanira ili monga lilili? Palibe chomwe chichotsedwa, ndipo kulowetsa sikudzalembedwanso pano.
interrupted-import-discard-confirm: Tayani kulowetsa uku? Bolodi lomwe kunapanga ndi zonse zomwe zili pamenepo zichotsedwa kwamuyaya.
interrupted-import-empty: Palibe kulowetsa mabolodi kosokonezedwa komwe kukudikira kuwunikidwa.
interrupted-import-truncated: Zakale kwambiri 50 zokha ndi zomwe zikuonetsedwa. Sungani kapena tayani zina ndipo tsitsaninso kuti muone zina.
interrupted-import-unavailable: Sitinathe kutsitsa kulowetsa mabolodi kosokonezedwa. Tsitsaninso kuti muyesenso.
interrupted-import-foreign-board: Bolodi lokhala ndi id iyi silinapangidwe ndi kulowetsa uku, choncho silinakhudzidwe.
interrupted-import-scrum-busy: Gawo lake la Scrum likulembedwabe kapena kubwezeretsedwa. Yesaninso pakapita mphindi zochepa.
interrupted-import-failed: Ntchitoyi sinathe kumalizidwa. Tsitsimutsani tsamba ndi kuyesanso.
saml-login-not-started: Kulowa uku ndi SAML sikunayambike pa tabu iyi ya msakatuli. Chonde lowaninso.
history-request-pending-undo: Seva sinatsimikizirebe kubweza kusintha kwanu komaliza.
history-request-pending-redo: Seva sinatsimikizirebe kuchitanso kusintha kwanu komaliza.
history-request-hint: Kuyesanso kumabwereza pempho lomwelo, choncho sikungabweze kusintha kwachiwiri.
scrum-history-checkpoint-stuck: Kubweza, kubwerezanso kapena kubwezeretsa zosintha za Scrum kunayima pa kusemphana. Kusintha kwa Scrum pa bolodi ili kwatsekerezedwa mpaka kutathetsedwa.
scrum-history-checkpoint-counts: Zosintha __applied__ mwa __total__ zinalembedwa, __pending__ sizinalembedwe, ndipo __conflicted__ zinasinthidwa ndi wina kuyambira pamenepo.
scrum-history-checkpoint-hint: Kubwezera mmbuyo kumabwezeretsa cholembedwa chilichonse chosinthidwa monga chinalili kale; kumaperekedwa pokhapokha palibe wina amene wasintha zolembedwazo kuyambira pamenepo. Kusunga bolodi monga lilili kumachotsa ntchito yoyimitsidwa ndipo sikusintha zolembedwa. Mulimonse momwe zingakhalire, zimalembedwa mu Gulu la oyang'anira, Mavuto, Kubwezeretsa.
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard-confirm: Sungani cholembedwa chilichonse monga chilili tsopano, kuphatikizapo zosintha zomwe ntchito yoyimitsidwa yalemba kale?
scrum-history-checkpoint-ask-admin: Woyang'anira bolodi angathe kulibwezera mmbuyo kapena kusunga bolodi monga lilili.
login-setting-clear-secret: Chotsani mtengo wosungidwa m'gulu la oyang'anira
login-setting-env-only: Malo a seva okha ndi omwe amaika izi. Zikuonetsedwa pano kuti ziwerengedwe zokha.
email-to-card-description: Imelo yotumizidwa ku adilesi ya bolodi lanu imakhala khadi pa bolodi limenelo.
email-to-card-webhook: URL ya webhook yolandira ya wopereka makalata (Mailgun, SendGrid, Postmark kapena MIME relay yaiwisi)
email-to-card-secret-saved: Zasungidwa - siyani chopanda kanthu kuti chisungidwe
email-to-card-imap-accounts: Mabokosi a makalata a IMAP owerengedwa
email-to-card-add-imap: Onjezani bokosi la makalata la IMAP
email-to-card-sandstorm-address: Adilesi ya imelo ya grain iyi
email-to-card-sandstorm-board: Bolodi limene maimelo otumizidwa ku grain iyi amapita
email-to-card-sandstorm-board-none: Palibe - maimelo okha okhala ndi chizindikiro cha bolodi pamutu
email-to-card-sandstorm-subject: Ikani izi pamutu kuti mufike pa bolodi ili monga inu nokha:
email-to-card-part-sender-line: Mzere wa wotumiza pamwamba pa kufotokozera
email-to-card-your-address: Adilesi yanu ya imelo ya bolodi ili
email-to-card-address-private: Isungeni mwachinsinsi: aliyense amene ali nayo akhoza kuwonjezera makhadi monga inu.
email-to-card-member-enabled: Maadilesi anga a bolodi amagwira ntchito
email-to-card-off-admin-off: Kulandira maimelo sikunakhazikitsidwe mu Gulu la oyang'anira.
email-to-card-off-board-off: Woyang'anira bolodi sanayatse imelo ya bolodi ili.
email-to-card-off-member-off: Mwazimitsa maadilesi anu a bolodi mu Zokonda za membala.
email-to-card-off-sandstorm-no-session: Grain ilibe adilesi yake ya imelo pakadali pano. Tsitsaninso tsambali.
email-to-card-off-not-authorized: Mukufuna chilolezo cholemba pa bolodi ili.
inbound-domain-invalid: Limenelo si dzina la domeni lovomerezeka.
inbound-domain-required: Perekani domeni ya maadilesi a bolodi.
inbound-account-invalid: Bokosi la makalata la IMAP likufuna dzina la seva lovomerezeka.
feature-views-email-desc: Bolodi ngati bokosi la makalata: mndandanda wa imelo ndi Bokosi lolandirira, mindandanda ndi mafoda, zilembo ndi zilembo, ndipo mamembala amalemba ndi kuyankha maimelo kuchokera ku adilesi ya bolodi.
email-view-not-receiving: Bolodi ili silinalandire imelo panobe. Iyatseni mu Zokonda za zidziwitso za bolodi → Imelo ku khadi.
email-view-invalid-address: Imodzi mwa maadilesi si adilesi yolondola ya imelo.
email-view-too-many: Maimelo ochuluka kwambiri atumizidwa mu ola lapitali. Yesaninso pambuyo pake.
feature-views-chat-desc: Bolodi ngati malo ochezera: malo ogwirira ntchito, mabolodi, njira, mindandanda ndi makhadi ngati mtengo wa matchanelo, khadi pakati ndi ndemanga zake ngati mauthenga a macheza.
chat-view-message-cards: Onetsani makhadi okhala ndi mauthenga okha
chat-view-pick-card: Sankhani khadi kuchokera ku matchanelo kuti muliwone pano.
feature-views-column-sets-desc: Makhadi omwewo m'magulu angapo a mizati okhala ndi mayina - mwa kumaliza, kufunika, gawo kapena china chilichonse - amasunthidwa pakati pa mizati pokoka.
feature-rule-suggestions-desc: Menyu ya bolodi → Malamulo amapereka malamulo kuchokera ku zomwe anthu amachita ndi manja mobwerezabwereza.
feature-board-summary-desc: Menyu ya bolodi → Chidule chimawonetsa zomwe aliyense anachita pa bolodi tsiku kapena sabata lomaliza, ndi zomwe zachedwa.
feature-since-last-visit-desc: Menyu ya bolodi → Kuyambira ulendo wanu womaliza ikuwonetsa zomwe ena asintha pa bolodi.
feature-search-phrases-desc: Kusaka konse kumamvetsa mawu ngati "makhadi anga omwe achedwa".
column-sets-empty: Palibe magulu a mizati pakadali pano. Woyang'anira bolodi angapange limodzi: lipatseni dzina, kenako onjezani mizati yake.
feature-views-version-control-desc: Bolodi ngati chotsatira mavuto cha GitHub kapena Gitea: makhadi ngati mavuto, zilembo ndi zochitika zazikulu, ndemanga ngati kukambirana, zolumikizidwa ngati mafayilo, ndi mbiri ya bolodi yokhala ndi kubweza.
vcs-no-issues: Palibe vuto lofanana ndi kufufuza uku.
vcs-no-milestones: Palibe zochitika zazikulu pano. Chilembo chokhala ndi tsiku lomaliza ndi chochitika chachikulu.
vcs-no-list: Bolodi ili lilibe mndandanda kapena njira ya vutoli.
card-qr-code-desc: Isikeni kuti mutsegule khadi ili pa foni kapena tabuleti.
card-qr-code-too-long: Ulalo wa khadi ili ndi wautali kwambiri pa khodi ya QR.
vcs-no-wiki: Palibe wiki pakadali pano. Kulowetsa bungwe la GitHub kumabweretsa wiki ya malo osungira kuno.
github-org-import-desc: Malo osungira aliwonse a bungwe kapena wogwiritsa ntchito amakhala bolodi lake, lotsegulidwa mu Board View / Version Control: mavuto ake ndi ndemanga, zilembo ndi mafayilo, zotulutsidwa zake, njira za ntchito za GitHub Actions ngati Malamulo, ndi wiki yake.
github-org-import-token-hint: Chikufunika pa malo osungira achinsinsi ndi malire apamwamba a API. Chimagwiritsidwa ntchito pokhapokha kulowetsa kukuchitika ndipo sichisungidwa konse.
github-org-import-issues: Mavuto, ndi ndemanga, zilembo ndi mafayilo
github-org-import-actions: Njira za ntchito za GitHub Actions ngati Malamulo
github-org-import-result: mavuto %s, zotulutsidwa %s, malamulo %s, masamba a wiki %s
github-org-import-owner-invalid: Lembani dzina la bungwe kapena wogwiritsa ntchito, kapena adilesi yake ya GitHub.
optional-apis-desc: Ma API a REST ofanana ndi ma API a otsata ena, kuti mapulogalamu ndi ma script awo agwiritse ntchito WeKan iyi ngati backend yawo: zomwe amasunga zimasungidwa mu WeKan, pa mabolodi a WeKan. Iliyonse imakhala yozimitsidwa mpaka itachongedwa pano. Palibe imene ili ndi ufulu wake: kasitomala amalowa ndi token ya WeKan API ndipo angaone ndi kusintha zokhazo zimene munthu ameneyo angaone ndi kusintha mu WeKan. Zonse zimafuna kuti WeKan REST API ikhale yoyatsidwa (WITH_API=true). Adilesi pansi pa iliyonse ndi imene kasitomala amagwiritsa ntchito ngati seva yake.
optional-api-trello-desc: Mapulogalamu ndi ma script olembedwera REST API ya Trello (mwachitsanzo Trellinator) amagwira ntchito ndi WeKan: mabolodi, mindandanda, makhadi, zilembo, mamembala, ndemanga ndi mindandanda yoyang'anira. Token ya Trello ndi token ya WeKan API. Kuchotsa khadi kumalisunga mu WeKan.
optional-api-jira-desc: Makasitomala a REST API v2 ya Jira amagwira ntchito ndi WeKan: projekiti ndi bolodi (kiyi yake ndi kiyi ya bolodi), vuto ndi khadi (DEV-7), momwe zilili ndi mndandanda, ndipo kusintha kumasuntha khadi. Kusaka kumalandira JQL yosavuta: project, status, assignee = currentUser(), text ndi ORDER BY. Lowani ndi token ya WeKan API ngati mawu achinsinsi. Kuchotsa vuto kumalisunga.
optional-api-github-desc: Makasitomala a REST API ya GitHub ya mavuto amagwira ntchito ndi WeKan: posungira (repository) ndi bolodi, vuto ndi khadi, ndi zilembo, zochitika zazikulu (zilembo zokhala ndi tsiku lomaliza), ndemanga, ndi otseguka kapena otsekedwa monga mu Maonekedwe a Bolodi / Kuyang'anira Mitundu. Token ndi token ya WeKan API.
optional-api-gitea-desc: Makasitomala a REST API ya Gitea ndi Forgejo ya mavuto amagwira ntchito ndi WeKan, mofanana ndi API yogwirizana ndi GitHub: posungira ndi bolodi ndipo vuto ndi khadi. Token ndi token ya WeKan API.
bots-none: Palibe maboti. Boti ndi wogwira ntchito pa seva yanu - wothandizira wa AI, ntchito ya CI, sikripiti - amene bolodi ili limampatsa makhadi.
bot-not-found: Boti limenelo silili pa bolodi ili.
bot-option-not-found: Yankho limenelo silili limodzi mwa omwe boti linapereka.
webhook-internal-hosts-desc: Ma webhook otuluka sangafike ku ma adilesi a pa netiweki ya WeKan yokha, kuti pasapezeke wina woloza webhook ya bolodi ku ntchito ya mkati. Lembani pano ma host a pa netiweki imeneyo amene ma webhook angafikeko - Node-RED, seva ya macheza - imodzi pa mzere uliwonse, ngati dzina kapena adilesi, pamodzi ndi port kuti mulole port imeneyo yokha. Chopanda kanthu: palibe. Oyang'anira tsamba okha ndi amene angasinthe mndandandawu.
account-webhook-desc: Adilesi imodzi yomwe WeKan imadziwitsa munthu akalowa kapena akaunti yatsopano ikapangidwa. Palibe chotumizidwa mpaka chochitika chomwe chili m'munsimu chisankhidwe. Chimanyamula chochitikacho, dzina la wogwiritsa ntchito ndi nthawi; sankhani magawo ena pokhapokha wolandira akawafuna.
account-webhook-field-ip: Adilesi ya IP komwe kulowako kunachokera
activity-recovery-cancel-older-prompt: Lekani zidziwitso zonse zodikira za ntchito zakale kuposa masiku angati?
vcs-synced-from: Yagwirizanitsidwa kuchokera ku %s: tsegulani ndi kutseka pamenepo.
vcs-synced-issue: Vuto ili lagwirizanitsidwa: litsegulani ndi kulitseka mu tracker yake.
sync-write-back: Lembani zosintha kubwerera ku GitLab: mutu, kufotokoza, ndemanga, kutseka ndi kutsegulanso
email-bounces-description: Zomwe WeKan imachita ndi imelo yomwe ibwerera: adilesi yolembedwa molakwika, bokosi lodzaza, yankho losapezeka, dandaulo la spam. Mtundu uliwonse uli ndi zochita zake, zomwe zimachitika ikabwerera kangapo kotero.
email-bounces-category-hard-desc: Adilesi palibe: kulakwitsa kalembedwe, akaunti yochotsedwa, domeni yosadziwika.
email-bounces-category-soft-desc: Sinafike pakadali pano: bokosi ladzaza, seva ili yotanganidwa. Zambiri zotsatizana zokha ndizo zimatanthauza kanthu.
email-bounces-category-auto-reply-desc: Mayankho a kusapezeka ku ofesi, tchuthi kapena makina a matikiti. Imelo inafika.
email-bounces-ses-description: Mu Amazon SES, tumizani zidziwitso za Bounce ndi Complaint, ndi lamulo lolandirira la adilesi yomwe WeKan imatumizira, ku mutu wa SNS, ndipo lembetsani adilesiyi kumeneko kudzera pa HTTPS:
email-bounces-ses-topics: Ma ARN a mitu ya SNS ovomerezeka, limodzi pa mzere uliwonse
email-bounces-stopped-only: Ma adilesi okha omwe WeKan siitumiziranso imelo
email-bounces-clear-hint: Iwalani kubwerera kwa adilesiyi ndipo itumizireninso imelo
email-bounce-invalid-topic: Imeneyo si ARN ya mutu wa SNS.
email-bounces-providers-description: Ngati WeKan imatumiza kudzera mu imodzi mwa ntchito izi, iyatseni, patsani ntchitoyo adilesi iyi ya webhook ya zochitika zake za maimelo obwerera ndi madandaulo a spam, ndipo matani apa kiyi yomwe imasaina nayo, kapena mawu achinsinsi omwe mudaika mu adilesi ngati https://user:password@… kapena ?secret=…
email-bounce-provider-secret-required: Ntchito yoyatsidwa ikufunika kiyi yake yosainira kapena mawu achinsinsi.
activity-pub-enabled: Mabolodi apoyera amafalitsa zochitika za makhadi awo pa fediverse (ActivityPub)
activity-pub-desc: Kozimitsidwa mwachisawawa. Ikayatsidwa, bolodi lililonse lapoyera litha kutsatiridwa kuchokera ku Mastodon ndi ma seva ena a fediverse ngati @board-<id> pa adilesi ya WeKan iyi, ndipo zochitika zatsopano za makhadi zimafika kwa otsatira ake. Ndi zowerenga zokha: palibe chimene seva ya fediverse imatumiza chimasintha bolodi, ndipo mabolodi achinsinsi sasindikizidwa konse.
caldav-sync-desc: Ikani masiku omaliza a makhadi a bolodi ili mu kalendala - Nextcloud Calendar kapena kalendala iliyonse ya CalDAV. Tsiku lomaliza losunthidwa mu kalendala limabwerera ku khadi. Gwiritsani ntchito mawu achinsinsi a pulogalamu, osati anu.
caldav-enabled: Lumikizani masiku omaliza ndi kalendala iyi
caldav-invalid-url: Adilesi ya kalendala iyenera kukhala adilesi ya http:// kapena https://, yopanda dzina la wogwiritsa ntchito kapena mawu achinsinsi.
caldav-not-linked: Choyamba sungani adilesi ya kalendala ndipo yatsani kulumikiza.
webdav-storage-description: Sungani zolumikizidwa mu foda pa seva ya WebDAV - Nextcloud Files, ownCloud kapena ina iliyonse. Gwiritsani ntchito mawu achinsinsi a pulogalamu opangidwira WeKan. Seva ya pa netiweki ya WeKan yokha ingagwiritsidwe ntchito pano, chifukwa woyang'anira tsamba yekha ndi amene amaika adilesi iyi.
sqrl-desc: Ndi yozimitsidwa poyamba. Ikayatsidwa, tsamba lolowera limapereka SQRL, ndipo mamembala amayamba kuonjezera chizindikiritso chawo cha SQRL mu Zokonda za membala. SQRL imafuna WeKan pa adilesi ya https://.
sqrl-scan: Jambulani khodiyo ndi pulogalamu yanu ya SQRL, kapena tsegulani kasitomala wanu wa SQRL pa chipangizochi.
sqrl-expired: Khodi iyi ya SQRL yatha ntchito. Yambaninso.
sqrl-needs-https: SQRL imafuna WeKan pa adilesi ya https://.
sqrl-description: Lowani ndi chizindikiritso chanu cha SQRL m'malo mwa mawu achinsinsi. Chionjezereni apa kamodzi ndi kasitomala wanu wa SQRL; mungachichotse apa nthawi iliyonse.
sqrl-none: Palibe chizindikiritso cha SQRL chomwe chawonjezedwa.
sqrl-disabled-by-client: Kulowa ndi SQRL kwazimitsidwa pa akawunti iyi kuchokera ku kasitomala wanu wa SQRL. Yatsaninso kumeneko ndi khodi yanu yopulumutsira.
sqrl-only-on: Kasitomala wanu wa SQRL watseka akawunti iyi ku SQRL yokha: njira zina zonse zolowera zikukanidwa.
sqrl-hardlock-on: Kasitomala wanu wa SQRL watseka akawunti iyi kotheratu: kukonzanso mawu achinsinsi ndi kusintha imelo zikukanidwa.
sqrl-only: Akawunti iyi imalowa ndi SQRL yokha.
sqrl-hardlock: Akawunti iyi yatsekedwa ku SQRL: singabwezeretsedwe kapena kusinthidwa mwanjira ina iliyonse.
windows-sso-failed: Kulowa ndi Windows kwalephera. Akaunti yanu ya Windows mwina siyiloledwa pano.
